description: Minimal showcase — verifies that a prompt triggers the right skill via load_skill. No MCP assertions, so these pass without live servers.

evals.prompt: Is a Deliveroo courier an employee or independent contractor under UK law? They set their own hours and use their own bike.
We need to dismiss a senior developer who returned from sick leave last month. They've had two written warnings. Is this safe to proceed?
A customer has emailed asking for all the data we hold on them. What do we need to do and by when?
